title: THE ATTIC IS A GAS CHAMBER! 💨

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: THE GAS IS LEAKING THROUGH THE VENTS [beat] COVER YOUR MOUTH WITH YOUR SHIRT BEFORE YOU PASS OUT!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: You always were too smart for your own good [beat] but my security system is smarter than a middle schooler with a grudge.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Nix [beat] the door handle is freezing cold and it won't even budge [beat] we're literally trapped like rats in a cage!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You’re a freaking psycho Jamal [beat] my dad is going to track my phone and he'll have the cops here in five minutes!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Check your signal kid [beat] this entire attic is lined with lead shielding and your precious GPS is currently pointing to a dumpster downtown.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Tuli [beat] look under the floorboards by the old trunk [beat] there's a loose panel where Grandpa used to hide his tools.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: I found it [beat] but it’s just a rusted hammer and a bunch of old wiring [beat] how is this supposed to save us from suffocating?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Don't use the hammer on the glass [beat] use it to smash the thermostat and short-circuit the entire security loop!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Desperation makes the mind move faster [beat] as the air turns thick and sweet with the smell of knockout gas.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: What are you doing in there [beat] stop touching those wires or I'll stop being nice and turn the oxygen off completely!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: The spark just set the insulation on fire [beat] nix [beat] the room is filling with smoke and I can't see the exit anymore!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Look at the wall [beat] the fire revealed a hidden staircase behind the bookshelf [beat] move it before the ceiling collapses!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: No [beat] you aren't supposed to know about the sub-basement [beat] if you go down there [beat] you'll see what happened to the others.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: We’re coming for you next Jamal [beat] and you better hope the police find you before I do!
